༄༅/ /bdag 'jug pad+ma klaung yangs bzhugs pa lags so/ /rin chen shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdag 'jug pad+ma klaung yangs bzhugs pa lags so/ /

rin chen shog skya'i skor/ bdag 'jug pad+ma klong yangs zhes bya ba/ rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde chen gar gyis dgyes mdzad cing*/ /gnyis med ye shes du ma'i gang chen mtsho/ /srid zhi'i bad ེ 'byung bde gshegs pad+ma la/ /bdag gzhan dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang gzhan don gnyis phun sum tshogs bya'i phyir/ /rang byung pad+ma'i gzhung lugs la brten nas/ /bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa gsal bar bya/ /de la mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor las dbang blangs te byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir dben pa'i gnas su rten gyi drung du phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ bum pa gnyis dang*/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa 'dir dgos pa rnams tshogs par byas la/ bgegs gtor byin nas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs te/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ srung 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ bdag nyid bskyed de mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung ngam mtha' bskor gyi mchod pa rnams bdud rtsi'i chus bsang zhing sbyangs te/ nam mkha' gang bar sprul/ rol mo'i sgras byin phab nas/ skad cig gis srung 'khor gyi nang 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug cing mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma dang po de bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyis pa gter bdag dam can/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi la phul nas/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par rigs lnga dang*/ las thams cad par rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed nas/ bzlas pa tshul bzhin du byas la mchod bstod la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid kun bzang yab yum du gsal btab nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mdun du dbang blangs te/

bla mas mdzad rgyu de rnams des mdzad la/ las kyi bya ba rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i kun tu bzang pos mdzad cing*/ slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis dngos su bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal phul thal mo sbyar la/ e ma dus gsum rgyal ba kun tu bzang*/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag khyed kyi rjes su 'jug /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang*/ /so thar byang sems dam tshig rnams/ /thar pa'i grong du 'jug bya'i phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la gnang du gsol/ /zhes pa gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas bla mas/ e ma snaud dang ldan pa'i bu//gsang sngags cho ga khyed la bstan/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyang*/ /gsang sngags cho ga 'di mkhyen pas// kun kyang sangs rgyas 'thob pa yin/ /kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga yis// bdud kyi dpung yang 'di yis bcom/ /de ltar khyod kyis 'thob bya'i phyir// 'di yi rjes su kun zhugs mdzod/ /ces gnang ba byin nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dgongs/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos rnams dang*/ /tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /zhes pa gsum dang yang*/ kun bzang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la/ /'di bzung bla med byang chub bar/ /gus pa yis ni skyabs su mchi// zhes pa gsum dang yang*/ dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong bcas/ /byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi// zhes pa gsum dang yang*/ bla ma kun bzang spyan snga ru/ /lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la/ /gnod pa las ldog dge ba bsgrub/ /dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems/ /so sor thar ba'i sdom pa la/ /bdag ni rgyun du gnas shing bsrung*/ /zhes pa gsum dang yang*/ ho bla ma kun bzang dgongs su gsol//

'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ /ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol dgrol dang dbugs dbyung phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhes pa gsum dang yang*/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ /sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar/ /'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bskyed par bgyi/ /pha rol phyin drug slob cing bsgrub/ /ba rtsa ོna 'grus dag gis thams cad bsgral/ /kun don tshul khrims rtag tu bsrung*/ /bdag gis sems bskyed sdom bzung nas/ /ma grol dgrol dang ma bsgral bsgral/ /dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pa gsum dang yang*/ /'di bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni mi gtong ngo*/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /sbyin pa rnams bzhi rtag tu gtong*/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /theg pa gsum gyi chos rnams bshad/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya/ /zhes sdom pa byin nas yang*/ /yar mchod gus shing mar la brtse/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung*/ /rtsa ba bzhi las 'da' mi bya/ / zhes brjod nas slob ma rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i gnas gsum dri'i thig le byas la/ oṃ badz+ra pra we sha ho/ zhes dril bu'i sgra res 'jog gis bla ma yi dam char bzhin du babs pas spyi bo nas mar thim par bsam zhing*/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rigs lnga'i lhas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag go /de nas chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/

/de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma ru/ /sngon du sdig pa gang byas pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'gyur/ /gang zhig spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ / ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas ni/ rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten dag ni mkhyen pa yi/ /go 'phang bla med thob par 'gyur/ / zhes brjod nas/ yang bla mas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / gsal zhing dngas la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de ni dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ / kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod nas gdong g.yogs bcings te phyi sgo bcad pa'i drung nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye kye khro bo mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ khyod kyis gnang ste btang du gsol/ /zhes pa gsum gyis zhus pas/ /nang nas bla mas/ khyed su yin ci byed ces dris pa'i lan du/ bdag ni skal ldan rigs kyi bu lags/ dpal rigs kyi bdag po la dbang zhu/ zhes lan btab nas/ bgegs bskrad de maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye rigs lnga'i bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ /bla ma yi dam ḍā ki dgongs/

/sgo ba chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /sgo phyi thar pa'i grong bstan 'tshal/ /zhes gsum brjod pas nang du phyin par bsams la/ thal mo sbyar te/ kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spangs na ni/ /skyob pa gzhan ni mi mnga' bas/ khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la stsol/ /zhes brjod pa dang*/ bla mas/ e ma khyod ni snod mchog dam pa ste/ khyod 'dod pa ni bdag gis sbyin/ / zhes pa dang*/ slob mas/ bdag ni 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyu na gyis/ /smin cing grol bar 'dod pas na/ /thugs rjes bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /ces pa gsum brjod dus/ /bla mas/ e ma e ma rigs kyi bu/ khyed ni las zad 'khrul pa zhig /rigs kyi bu mchog khyed yin pas/ /ngas khyod kun bzang rigs lnga yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug cing ye shes dbab/ /dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis 'thob/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor 'di dag ni/ /ma mthong ba la smras pa na/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar ltung*/ /bsrungs na dngos grub khyed kyis thob/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thungs/ /ā+oṃ a mṛ ta dam las ma 'da' swā hā/ 'o khyod kyi ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas nga yin pas/ /ngas bsgo ba las ma 'da' zhig / 'das na myur du rdo rje dmyal bar skyes nas thon pa'i dus med do/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrag go /ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ snying nang du g.yung drung dmar po'i nang du zla ba'i steng du yaṃ/ yan lag bzhi la/ ha ri ni sa bzhi bsams la/ yaṃ las rlung byung bas g.yung drung g.yon du 'khor bar bsams la/ gu gul nag po/ bdud rtsi lnga/ byi la'i brun/ zla mtshan/ ra'i nya sha rnams sbyar ba bsregs la/ rol mo'i sgra dang rtsa sngags brjod cing*/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rang la sib sib thim par bsam mo/ /de nas sgo bzhir rim gyis phyin par mos la/ kye shar sgo srung ba'i sgo ba lcags kyu ma/

/shar gyi sgo 'di phye la ni/ /bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod/ /kye lho sgo srung ba'i sgo ba zhags pa ma/ /lho yi sgo 'di phye la ni/ /bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod/ / kye nub sgo srung ba'i sgo ba lcags sgrog ma/ /nub kyi sgo 'di phye la ni/ /bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod/ /kye byang sgo srung ba'i sgo ba dril bu ma/ / byang gi sgo 'di phye la ni/ /bdag cag yi dam lha dang sprod/ /ces brjod nas me tog thogs la/ kye bde gshegs rigs lnga'i pho brang du/ /'brel ba'i me tog 'di dor bas/ /sngon nas 'brel pa gang yod pa'i/ /yi dam lha dang bdag 'phrad shog/ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe (< a > sid+dha ི) si ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes me tog dong nas/ bla mas/ ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis/ khyed kyi ma rig 'khor ba'i mig /ye shes spyan du dbye bar bya/ /de bzhin khyod kyis 'gro ba rnams/ /ye shes spyan du 'byed par shog /ā+oṃ tsak+ṣu swāhā/ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol lo/ /yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu rnams kun/ khyed rnams sdig pa kun las grol/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ltos/ /lus ngag yid kyis dad pa bskyed/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis 'thob/ /dam tshig sngags la brtson par gyis/ /zhes pas dkyil 'khor bltas te/ bum dbang gi don du/ /maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /kun bzang yab yum ye shes dbang*/ /bdag cag rnams la bskur du gsol/ /zhes pa gsum brjod nas/ shar sgo seng ge'i khri la 'dug par gyur pa la/ me tog gang la phag pa 'di/ /sngon nas khyod kyi yi dam lha/ /rtag tu bsgom dang bsgrub par gyis/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ( <a3gt;sid+dhi ) si ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas me tog blangs te gang la phog pa'i lhar bsgom nas/ yang rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yab yum du bsam pa'i spyi bor ā+oṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ bla mas rnam rgyal bum pa bzung bar bsam la/ hūm̐ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa'i/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis chu 'di 'thungs shing bkrus pa tsam gyis lus kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas 'di nyid du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dbang thob pa yin no/ khyod kyi gzugs kyi phung po 'di rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du sangs rgyas te/ chu yi khams mā ma kī yi rang bzhin du gnas 'gyur/ zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi sku 'gyur ba med pa thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byed par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /gsung gi dbang ni/ slob ma snang ba mtha' yas dmar por bsam pa'i mgrin par āḥlas snga ma bzhin bsam zhing*/ bla mas rdo rje bzung nas/ hūṃ 'du shes phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i/ /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis/ / dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrī/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyi lag tu rdo rje 'di gtad pa tsam gyis ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du shes kyi phung po snang ba mtha' yas nyid du sangs rgyas te/ me'i khams kyang gos dkar mo'i rang bzhin nyid du gnas/ 'dod chags so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rigs kyi gsung 'gags pa med pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod do/ / thugs kyi dbang ni/ slob ma rnam snang mthing ga'i thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las snga ma bzhin dmigs te bla mas/ hūṃ rnams shes phung po rnam dag cing*/

nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ bhud+dha a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la pad+ma las 'brel rtsal zhes ming btags pa tsam gyis/ 'dir yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po yang rnam par snang mdzad nyid du sangs rgyas te/ nam mkha'i khams kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phug mar dag nas/ gti mug chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi thugs 'khrul pa med pa chos kyi sku thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod do/ yon tan gyi dbang ni/ slob ma rin chen 'byung ldan du bsam pa'i lte bar trāṃ las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dngos grub thob par bsam la/ dbu rgyan bskon par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag cing*/ nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa'i/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro//ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbu rgyan 'di bskon pa tsam gyis 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan du sangs rgyas te/ sa'i khams kyang sangs rgyas spyan du dag nas nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rin chen rigs kyi yon tan thams cad mkhyen pa thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod do/ /phrin las kyi dbang ni/ slob ma don grub tu dmigs pa'i gsang bar āḥlas 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ bla mas dril bu bzung ste/ hūṃ 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing*/

/nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa'i/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dril bu 'di gtad pa tsam gyis 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa ma lus pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du byed kyi phung po yang don yod grub par sangs rgyas te/ rlung gi khams dam tshig sgrol mar dag nas/ phrag dog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i phrin las thogs pa med pa grub nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod do/ /kun tu bzang po'i dbang ni/ slob ma kun tu bzang po mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par bsam la/ bla mas rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*/ /snang stong dbyer med 'di zung la/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yi/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis/ /'gro kun rjes su gzung bar gyis/ /'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rdo rje dang dril bu 'di gtad pa tsam gyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon thebs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob pa yin no/ /rang gi sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med par 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do/ /chus dbang ni/ bla mas bum pa rang gi spyi bor bzung bar bsam la/ hūm̐ rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das/ /mā ma kī yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ snang ba mtha' yas bcom ldan 'das/ /gos dkar mo yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/

/ rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /kun tu bzang mo'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ rin chen 'byung ldan bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyis chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /hūm̐ don yod grub pa bcom ldan 'das/ /dam tshig sgrol ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ aḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhāk+ki ni sid+dhi pha la hūṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñca bh+rūṃ si ti

(<a3gt; sid+dhi ) pha la hūm̐ āḥ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa bum pa'i dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor gyur pa yin pas/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la brnyas pa byas na ltung bar 'gyur bas dag snang dang mos gus gyis la mchod pa dang bstod pa la dga' bas lha'i rang bzhin du ngo shes par gyis shig /ces brjod la bum chu cung zad 'thungs pa dang khrus bya'o/ /de nas brda'i dbang ni/ bla mas 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rigs lnga'i sku bstan pa tsam gyis ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin gyis/ rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs nas sems can gyi don rlabs po che byed par 'gyur ro// zhes brda bstan par bya'o/ /don gyi dbang ni bla mas/ 'o rigs kyi bu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis kyang rang gi rig pa'i don las logs na ma grub pas/ lus sems gnyis kyi 'byung ba dang*/ khams dang skye mched thams cad kyang sangs rgyas rigs lnga yab yum du lhun gyis grub pas sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs par yid ches par gyis shig /ces ngo shes shing dran par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi dbang ni/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag nas/ bla mas e ma rigs kyi bu nyon cig /thun mong skyabs 'gro nas brtsams pa'i/ so thar byang sems bslab bya dang*/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig kun/ /byang chub ma thob bar du ni/ /srog gi phyir yang ma gtong zhig /dam tshig nyam na bskal pa ru/ /ngan song gsum nas thar mi srid/ /de phyir srungs shig rigs kyi bu/ /zhes brjod pas don dran par bya'o/ /des ni lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang ba dang*/ lus kyi sdig pa dag nas sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/

/rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa dam tshig gi rdzas rnams brten zhing byams pa dang snying rjes 'gro ba la phan par bya'o/ /zhes bla mas gdams par bsam mo/ /de nas gsang dbang gi don du/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su 'dug par bsams nas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ yid kyis bla ma la rig ma phul la/ e ma ho lha mo bde ba che/ /bde chen pad+ma he ru ka /bde gshegs rnams kyi bde chen yab/ /bde ba'i dbang phyug bde stsol mdzod/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag don/ /rnam dag mchog ni yang dag pa'i/ /dri med bdud rtsi (< a > gang ba ) dam pa yis/ /bla med mchog gi dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin rigs kyi bu dag la/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal mdzod/ / dri med ye shes bdud rtsi yis/ /ma rig nyes pa'i dri ma 'joms/ /bla med byang chub bde chen nyid/ /dus 'dir bdag gis thob mdzod cig /ces phul ba'i rjes la/ gdong g.yogs bcings la rdo rje phag mor skad cig gis gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung sum brtsegs kyi dbus su phag mo tshon gang ba gcig bsgoms te rol mo'i sgras rtsa sngags zlos shing ye shes phab nas/ gdang g.yogs phye la bla mas/ 'byung ba'i gdang las grub pa yi/ /lus 'di bde gshegs pho brang nyid/ /rigs lnga yab yum lnga yi gnas/ /phung khams skye mched lha yi sku/ / zhes pas lhar nges shes bskyed nas/ /me tog phog pa'i lha lus la ngo sprad la/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu lce thog tu bzhag nas/ dbang dngos bskur ba/ kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ni/ /byang chub sras po dam pa la/ /ji ltar dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i byang sems kyis/ /da lta khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa tsa hri ya bho dhi tsit+ta a mṛ te sarba pañca a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes pa gsum gyis lus thams cad bde stong du gsal btab nas bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/

/bde dang stong pa dbyer med pa/ /de nyid ltos dang ngos bzung bral/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang*/ /thams cad ro mnyams bde chen nyid/ /ces pa gsum gyis ngo sprad la/ rjes su/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig gnyan po 'di/ /ye shes sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ /dmar chen ga pur tsan+dan sbyar/ /rdo rje chu yis kun tu bsre/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun mthun mtshungs/ /'di dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ / rgyun du yang dang yang du brten/ /'di ni dam tshig bla na med/ /ma nyams skal ldan khyod kyis srungs/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ nub phyogs su 'dug par mos la gsol ba gdab pa/ kye kye bcom ldan bde chen chos kyi dbyings/ / rnal 'byor rdo rje mi phyed bdag /yang dag phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las ni byung*/ /bdag nyid chen po kun bdag nyid/ /mnga' dbang bdag la'ang de nyid stsol/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam du ni/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes pa gsum brjod nas bla mas/ e ma gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dam tshig bsrung bya sems la chongs/ /bud med mi spang dang du blang*/ /tshangs spyod don la gnas par bya/ /yon tan thams cad 'di las 'byung*/ /'di spangs bde ba'i dngos grub med/ / nyams pa mkha' 'gro'i chad pa yis/ /tshe 'phos dmyal ba dag tu ltung*/ / zhes pa gsum gyis dam tshig byin nas/ slob mas/ shi'am srog la bab gyur tam/ bya dga' chen po nyid byung yang*/ /dam tshig bka' las 'da' mi byed/ /sa ma ya na ra kan/ zhes pa gsum brjod nas/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ thams cad rdo rje phag mor bsgoms la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas rdo rje phag mo phra mo mang po byung ba slob ma'i snying nang du thim par bsam zhing rol mo dkrol nas/ gdong g.yogs phye la bla mas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/

/bha ga'i dbyings nas rang byung ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /bha ga gsang sngags kun gyi gnas/ /bde chen ye shes 'byung ba yin/ /'di nyid ma brten thabs gzhan med/ /thabs kyi rgyud kyis grol ba yin/ /bde chen 'di brten bde ba thob/ /yang dag sangs rgyas 'di las byung*/ /bud med tsam la khro ba spangs/ /mtshan ldan yum la gus par gyis/ / zhes brjod pas/ yum gyis/ hūm̐ nga yi bha ga gsang chen 'di/ /gang zhig mos pas sus brten pa/ /yon tan dngos grub thams cad 'byung*/ /bde stong mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /ā+oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya añja li hoḥ zhes brjod par bsams nas/ bla mas slob ma la gtad pa/ hūm̐ ye shes lha mo bde ba'i sku/ /kun tu bde ba'i gnas sbyin ma/ /dga' bas gzugs mdzes yid 'ong ma/ /'di khyed dpa' bo sems dpa' che/ /rtag tu gus pas mchod par gyis/ /oṃ mahā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod nas/ snyoms par zhugs par bsams te bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /bde stong gnyis med don de la/ / der 'dzin ma byed ngo la ltos/ /gnyis shor gnyis mnyam dus 'di ru/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char/ /de ni de yis zin par mdzod/ /ces brjod nas yang*/ /e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /des ni dag phyag gang dag na/ / nyon mongs yid kyi sgrib pa dag /las kyi phyag rgya brten par dbang*/ /skal pa sa bcu dag dang mnyam/ /'phrin las dbang gi las rnams 'grub/ / 'bras bu skye med chos sku thob/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas tshig dbang rin po che'i don du byang nas maṇ+ḍal phul bar bsams la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye kye dus gsum bla ma rje/ /yang dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ye shes la/ /bdag nyid nges pa'i shes pa skye/ /gnyis med ye shes mchog de nyid/ /'gro gzhan dag la yod pa min/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i mchog 'di nyid/

/'thung phyir bdag gi bla ma la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /gal te don thal bdag gis 'tshal/ /rnam pa kun tu mchog gyur pa'i/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bdag la stsal/ /zhes pa gsum brjod pa dang*/ bla mas/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm/ bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig ni/ /thams cad ro snyoms chos nyid ngang*/ /'khor 'das spang blang bral ba yi/ /gang shar chos nyid rol pa la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas ma bslad srungs/ 'das na 'khor ldog na ra kan/ /zhes brjod nas/ slob ma'i smin phrag tu g.yung drung dmar po 'khor ba la dmigs shing*/ /bla ma yi dam sprin phung gtibs pa tsam thim par bsams nas/ dar cig mnyam par gzhag go /de nas nam mkha'i phyogs bzhir slob mas rim par blta zhing bla mas/ e ma e ma rigs kyi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i shar du ltos/ /shar gyi bar snang dag la ni/ /thogs pa med pa 'gro bar sgoms/ /kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ / mig rtse nam mkha'i lho dang nub/ /byang du bltas te 'gro bar sgoms/ /'gro bar bsams na 'gro mkhan med/ /gang du 'gro bsam phyin pa med/ /'gro bar bsam pa rang gi sems/ /sems ni mtha' bral stong pa yin/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /sems ni dang po gang nas byung*/ / rgyu rkyen ci las byung ba ltos/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod nyon/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid la/ /gdod nas ma skyes dngos po med/ kha dog dbyibs med ngos gzung med/ /gang nas ma byung song ba med/ /da ltar mi gnas rgyu rkyen med/ /'di nyid sems kyi gnas lugs te/ /brjod du med par shes par gyis/ /zhes pa dang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ / rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di la ltos/ /rgyan dang cha lugs du mar snang*/ /snang bar 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /de la ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral/ /de bzhin yid yul snang ba'i gzugs/ /yul nyid gsal la mkhan pos stong*/ /de ni gsal stong chos sku yin/

/zhes pa dang yang*/ e ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ / 'di yi sgra ni snyan mi snyan/ /legs par thos sam ngo bor ltos/ /sgra ru 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /sems ni grags stong chos kyi sku/ /de la ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral/ / de bzhin sgra ru grags pa kun/ /sna tshogs thos kyang ngo bos stong*/ /gsal por grags kyang rang bzhin stong*/ /ngos gzung ma rnyed gzhi rtsa bral/ /de ni grags stong chos sku yin/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ e ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ / spos dang sman sogs dri zhim dang*/ /de bzhin dri mi zhim snom la/ /dga' dang mi dga' skyes pa'i sems/ /de nyid ngo la tshur ltos dang*/ /de yi ngo bo ci 'dra zhig /brtags pas ma rnyed rgyu mtshan med/ /gnyis 'dzin shes pa glo bur yin/ /rkyen phyir snang yang ngo bos stong*/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ e ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /bza' btung ro mchog myong bar gyis/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha kha bska/ /ro drug myong ba'i mkhan por ltos/ / bltas pas me rnyed skye ba med/ /mtha' bral dbu ma spros bral dang*/ /rang grol chos skur shes par mdzod/ /ces pa dang yang*/ e ma rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /reg la dgag sgrub bskyed pa'i sems/ /de la gnyis 'dzin gang byung yang*/ /rnam pa gsal la rang bzhin stong*/ /ngo bo med la gzhi rtsa bral/ /ye nas stong gsal chos sku yin/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /rang gi sems la tshur ltos dang*/ /dgag sgrub bde sdug cig shar yang*/ /gsal la ngo bo rig stong yin/ /dper na chu zla ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /nyon mongs sna tshogs ci skyis kyang*/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /sems la snang yang ngos gzung med/ /nyon mongs gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ kha dog dbyibs med ngos gzung med/ /gdod nas ma skyes chos sku yin/ /nyon mongs rtog pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /sems las byung zhing sems su nub/

/skyes dang grol mnyam rba rlabs bzhin/ /phra rags sems dang rnam rtog kun/ /ye stong gzhi med rtsa bral yin/ /de ltar rtog pa'i mtshang rtogs na/ /gnyen po spang blang med par grol/ /ces brjod cing*/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo gsal gdab bo/ /rjes ni yang bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /stong gsal chos sku'i dbang thob pa/ /des ni dag bya gang dag na/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib dag /gsum ka'i nus pa tshad du phyin/ /brtan bya bde sdug spang blang bral/ /rjes su dbyer med bsgom par gnad/ /sa ni bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /'phrin las bzhi pa mngon du gyur/ /'bras bu sku lnga lhun grub thob/ / ces brjod pa dang*/ / maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas brtsams te bdag gis ni/ /lus dang longs spyod dngos kun gyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed mchod kyis/ /khyed kyi rjes su gzung bar mdzod/ /ces pas gtang rag phul nas/ des 'dus pa rnams la tshogs kyi dga' bas mnyes par byas te/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad ma lus kun/ /kun tu bzang po rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ma lus phyam cig thams cad lhun grub nas/ /bde gshegs rnams dang skal pa mnyam par shog /ces dngos dang ras bris la sogs pa brtan par gyur pa mi gshegs par/ /tshom bu la sogs pa'i lha dang mgron rnams ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa bdag la thim par bsams la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs bsrungs te/ lhag ma'i gtor ma dang*/ rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /chos tshul 'di ni zab yangs rgya mtsho'i sprin/

/skal ldan skye bo'i phun tshogs sgrub byed yin/ /gang 'dir snying ga 'od kyi pad+ma la/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i 'od zer phog pa yis/ /byams dang snying rje'i 'dab ma rab rgyas te/ /dad ldan rkang drug nyer 'tsho'i longs spyod du/ /pad+ma las 'bra ེ la rtsal gyis legs par bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu rab bzhugs te/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ston gsum me tog 'bras bur smin pa'i tshe/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /'phags pa'i ri ngogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /pad+ma klong yangs rab tu rgyas pa yis/ /lha dang drang srong mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ /blo gsal sbrang rtsir spyod rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /bdag 'jug pad+ma klong yangs zhes bya ba/ / o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi gnas mchog dam par ston gyi tshe me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i dus su bkod pa'o/ /phyogs dus kun tu bde chen gyi char bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su nye bar gnas pa bzhin 'bab par shog cig
/shubhaṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)bdag 'jug pad+ma klaung yangs/ -PAGE 464--PAGE 481--PAGE 463-
